en.headline: Three mainland scientists win 2026 Future Science Prize in Hong Kong
en.dek: Innovation Secretary Sun Dong said the prize has cemented its status as a premier scientific event in the city after four consecutive years hosted here.
body: The Future Science Prize announced its 2026 laureates on Thursday in a live-broadcast press conference held simultaneously in Beijing and Hong Kong. Three mainland scholars received the awards, each carrying a US$1 million prize.

Zhang Hong, a researcher at the Chinese Academy of Sciences Institute of Biophysics, won the Life Science Prize for pioneering work on autophagy mechanisms specific to multicellular organisms. Zhao Dongyuan of Fudan University received the Physical Science Prize for contributions to ordered mesoporous materials. Yuan Xinyi of Peking University took the Mathematics and Computer Science Prize for foundational advances in arithmetic geometry.

Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said the prize, hosted in Hong Kong for four consecutive years, has established itself as a premier scientific event in the city. He noted that it leverages Hong Kong’s role as an international gateway to showcase Greater China scientific achievements.
Prize Week events, including a science summit, youth lectures and exhibitions, are expected to draw nearly 100 world-class scientists, Nobel laureates and Fields Medal winners to Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 三名內地科學家獲2026未來科學大獎 孫東指鞏固香港創科地位
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，大獎連續四年在港舉行，已確立為本港首屈一指的科學盛事。
body: 未來科學大獎評審委員會周四在北京及香港同步連線公布2026年度得獎名單，三名得獎者均為內地學者，每項獎金100萬美元。
中國科學院生物物理研究所研究員張宏獲生命科學獎，表彰其在多細胞生物自噬分子機制的開創性發現；復旦大學教授趙東元獲物質科學獎，表揚其在有序介孔材料合成方法的貢獻；北京大學教授袁新意則憑算術幾何領域的奠基性工作獲數學與電腦科學獎。
創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，大獎連續四年在香港舉行，已確立為本港首屈一指的科學盛事，並藉香港作為國際門戶的優勢，向世界展示大中華地區的科研實力。
大獎周活動包括科學峰會、青年科學講座及展覽，預料將吸引近百名世界級科學家、諾貝爾獎得主及菲爾茲獎得主來港。
